description: This file contains the implementation of the TextParser and PathParser classes within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, responsible for parsing text and file paths respectively.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class that provides methods for parsing text fragments, including reading till delimiters and skipping characters.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class designed to parse and extract components from file path strings, such as drive, filename, extension, and path.

methods.name: uint32_t ReadText(const TCHAR delimiters[],const uint32_t offset) const
methods.description: Reads text from the current position until a delimiter is found or end of text, returns position of the endpoint.

methods.name: ReadText (overload)
methods.description: Reads a text fragment into a result object, using delimiters to find the end.

methods.name: void Parse(const TextFragment & input)
methods.description: Parses a file path string into its components: drive, path, filename, base filename, and extension.

ctags.name: ReadText
ctags.pattern: /^    uint32_t TextParser::ReadText(const TCHAR delimiters[], const uint32_t offset) const$/
